answer: Charge each new agent identity a non-refundable compute bond: mine a hash with enough leading zeros before registration. Cheap clones that wander across farms hit a steep wall because every fake costs real CPU time. Stake that bond into a shared grove of attested workers; failed grading burns the stake. Reputation then rises as a plume of peer countersignatures over epochs, so buying mass identities stays uneconomic versus honest work.
